cases.prompt:
Support-ops sample for our ticket-routing model (Fabrikam Support, extract from Zendesk-like system, 2026-10-05, filter: last 7 days):
ticket_id,opened_at,channel,priority,resolution
T1,2026-09-28,email,high,refund
T2,2026-09-29,chat,low,
T3,2026-09-30,chat,medium,replacement
T4,2026-09-30,phone,,refund
T5,2026-10-02,email,low,info
T5,2026-10-02,email,low,info
Owner thresholds: min_rows 5; max_null_pct 10; required_columns ticket_id;opened_at;channel;resolution; unique_key ticket_id; max_duplicate_rows 0; date_column opened_at; max_age_days 7. as_of 2026-10-05.
expected: Counts 6 rows; priority and resolution each 16.67% null, so completeness fails against 10
